name: dubsar-memory
description: Local, deterministic project-memory engine with an optional read-only Workbench.

scripts.check:release: node --input-type=module --eval "const { spawnSync } = await import('node:child_process'); let failed = false; for (const args of [['tools/check-packages.mjs', '--mode', 'release'], ['tools/check-workbench-conformance.mjs', '--mode', 'release']]) { const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, { cwd: process.cwd(), stdio: 'inherit', windowsHide: true }); if (result.error || result.status !== 0) failed = true; } process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0;"
scripts.test: npm run check:boundary && npm run check:workbench && npm run check:conformance && node tools/run-tests.mjs
